bestBets.overview: There was money for HELLFIRE JESS when she finished midfield in the Murray Bridge Magic Millions in March. She has placed in two recent jumpouts and finds a winnable race to resume in. IMMORTALLY LUCKY was runner-up at Balaklava at her second outing. She can settle handy to the speed here from a good draw. CALM THE PRESS led them up at Naracoorte last time but couldn't match it with Lots Of Torque late. He's bound to be fitter again. THE MUSCLE finished just behind the placegetters at Balaklava on debut last month. LOUELLA FLY won a Murtoa jumpout on July 29th.

raceTips.comment: Hellfire Jess had specking on debut in the Maribyrnong Plate and then tackled the MM 2YO Classic at Murray Bridge. She’s had the two jump-outs and looks primed from a good gate. Calm The Press ran well at Naracoorte running 2nd behind Lots Of Torque and draws a good gate. Immortally Lucky showed improvement at second start when 2nd behind Azytass, who goes to the city on Saturday, at Balaklava. The Muscle ran well on debut running 4th in that race on debut.

bestBets.overview: TANNA finished a close third behind Sioux Warrior over this trip at Murray Bridge three starts ago. He was found to be lame after finishing down the track at Balaklava last time. NANKEEN raced well over this trip when last in work. He was not far from the winner in the finish at Naracoorte last time. ZUETORO has won when fresh in the past. He was runner-up to Aztec Dancer at Murray Bridge over this journey in December. EMMOOKI MAGIC notched up her second career win when able to lead throughout at Balaklava three weeks ago. JUST LIKE LISA has been racing as though in need of further so the drop back to 900m is a concern.

raceTips.comment: Just Like Lisa has been bursting to win a race running 4th at Balaklava two runs back and was fa when 2nd to Lord Porchester at Naracoorte last time out. She gets her chance here. Nankeen comes throughout that Naracoorte race running 5th. Emmooki Magic had specking at a price before leading throughout to win at Balaklava last time and she draws a good barrier. Zuetoro defeated Taking Omaha at Murray Bridge back in Nov and can run a race from a good gate. He has jumped-out OK. Tanna ran well when 4th at Mildura two runs back and was a touch plain last time out. Crackle And Burn has been in the money at all three runs here.

bestBets.overview: PIANTA got the money this route in June. Two subsequent runs have been good, he looks a good each-way chance again. WIMMERA STAR was placed behind the in-form Petit Eagle at Murray Bridge last start. He's better suited stepping up to 2050m. FUWARI finished midfield at Warrnambool when resuming over 1700m. She'll strip fitter for that and is suited by the step up in trip. SIDE PIECE made it two wins on the trot when he scored over 1700m a fortnight ago. He has to carry 4kg more today.

raceTips.comment: Side Piece is chasing three in succession here after winning at Hamilton and Warrnambool. He has plenty of weight but should love the heavy conditions. Fuwari ran 5th in that race and was a Bendigo winner last prep. Wimmera Star comes off a good Murray Bridge when 3rd behind Petit Eagle. He draws a nice gate. Badonkidonk was sent out fav at Naracoorte last time but a touch plain running 6th. Pianta is a two-time winner here and placed last time out.

bestBets.overview: HIDDEN BOUNTY returned to form with a tough win over Aquaholic at Naracoorte. This is easier and she has won here in the past. ROBERT THE PUSS overcame trouble to land the money here two starts ago. He found the class too strong at Morphettville last time. TALLAPOOSA has finished in the placings at her past couple of runs, only going down narrowly at Warrnambool last time. LIMOSA has had the benefit of two runs back from a spell. The extra 100m is a plus for her. BIT OF A REBEL can figure if things go his way, but he will need some luck from an awkward draw.

raceTips.comment: Robert The Puss has been in the money at both runs here, winning two starts back before an OK Morphettville run. Hidden Beauty is a winner at her only start here and comes off a Naracoorte win last start. Loose Lip Lloyd was 6th in that race but has won 8 of 19 starts here. Tallapoosa has been placed at her past couple. Bit Of A Rebel strips fitter here and gets some needed weight relief. Surfy Pete is a winner on a Heavy track and strips fitter for one run back. Heart’s Embrace was a Colac maiden winner last time in work. Limosa ran well at big odds first-up at Geelong.

bestBets.overview: GUSTY WAY was too strong for Symphonite in the finish here two starts ago. He made it two wins on the trot when he came out and won a fortnight later. TERRALIGHT is another coming into this after winning two in a row. She won her maiden here two starts ago, then stepped up in grade and was too strong for Tallapoosa at Warrnambool. NARALINGA is down in grade after finishing down the track at Morphettville last week. Two runs prior to that were good. SHOUT ME came from behind the speed to defeat Come Along Jeffrey this route last month. HALLIWELL has been mixing her form in stronger races this prep. She may improve in this company.

raceTips.comment: Gusty Way is chasing three in a row coming off a Naracoorte win and has been in the money all three runs here. He beat Naralinga last time who then ran OK in city class at Morphettville last week. Terralight was a good winner here as fav before winning at Warrnambool at big odds. She draws out. Symphonite has been racing well running 2nd here last time and maps well. Halliwell can improve here on a Heavy track. Aquaholic has been bursting to win a race but draws a sticky gate. Shout Me has a good record here on his home deck.

formRaceEntries.comment: Bit Slow Out went Straight Out The Back 8 Lengths . came widest in Straight , worked home under big weight to finish 4th # ran on from last
formRaceEntries.commentStewards: slow to begin. RE her instructions were to find cover from the wide gate. After being slow away and the formation of the field to her inside, she was of the opinion her best option to find cover was at the rear of the field and not be caught wide. She further added HALLIWELL (NZ) travelled very well throughout the event and when  asked to improve inside the 500m, the mare finished the race off strongly.

formRaceEntries.comment: began well, led early then passed & Took A Sit 2nd 2 Lengths . Ridden Along into Straight , Dropped Out from 200m # couldn't finish off
formRaceEntries.commentStewards: Raced keenly. In the vicinity of the 800m was tightened onto a/r when attempting to improve to the outside of a/r which shifted out. Laid out in the straight. RE the gelding only travelled fairly throughout the event however when placed under pressure from the 500m began to lay out and inside the 200m SHOUT ME hung out, and for this reason he elected to ease the gelding down over the final 100m. Mr K. Post was advised a warning had been placed on the gelding in relation to its racing manners. 10/08 K Post advised - pulled up well, continue with prep.
